Class ApplicationManifest

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.runner.build.ApplicationManifest
public final class ApplicationManifest extends Object
The part of an application's manifest the packaging library reads, for a build tool that describes that manifest in its own model rather than as a file.

The library reads seven attributes: Specification-Title, Specification-Version, Specification-Vendor, Implementation-Title, Implementation-Version, Implementation-Vendor and Sealed, in the main section and in package sections, whose names end in /. They reach the runner jar's manifest and the index, where the launcher defines each Package with them. Every other attribute and section is ignored.

A plugin collects its manifest configuration as plain strings, keeps what filter(Map, Map) keeps, which is small and stable enough to be a task input, and passes toManifest(SortedMap) of it to RunnerJarSpec.Builder.applicationManifest(Manifest).

Since:
1.0

  • Method Details

    • isConsumed

      public static boolean isConsumed(String attributeName)
      Whether the packaging library reads an attribute: one of Specification-Title, Specification-Version, Specification-Vendor, Implementation-Title, Implementation-Version, Implementation-Vendor and Sealed. Names are compared without regard to case, as Attributes.Name compares them.
      Parameters:
      attributeName - an attribute name
      Returns:
      whether the library reads it
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if attributeName is null

    • filter

      public static SortedMap<String,String> filter(Map<String,String> main, Map<String, Map<String,String>> sections)
      Keeps what the packaging library reads of a manifest.

      The result is keyed by Name for a main attribute and by <section>Name for an attribute of a package section, such as com/example/Implementation-Version. Only consumed attributes are kept, written with their canonical spelling, and only sections whose names end in /. An attribute whose name or value is null is left out.

      Parameters:
      main - the main attributes, by name
      sections - the named sections' attributes, by section name
      Returns:
      the consumed attributes, sorted by key
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if main or sections is null

    • toManifest

      public static Manifest toManifest(SortedMap<String,String> consumed)
      Builds the application manifest from filter(Map, Map)'s result: Manifest-Version: 1.0, then the main attributes, then the package sections. A key without a / is a main attribute; any other key is split at its last / into a section name, which keeps the /, and an attribute name.
      Parameters:
      consumed - the attributes, as filter(Map, Map) returns them
      Returns:
      a new manifest
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if consumed is null
